_comment: Ratchet expectations for the opt-in corpus sweep (plan invariants I1/I2).
These are AGGREGATE budgets only - no file names, no structural data - so
they are safe to commit while the corpus itself stays private.
Counts may only ever go DOWN. Lower them as fixes land; never raise them
to make a failing run pass.

fixed_failure_categories.encoded_coordinates: An atom whose coordinates use the '10*m + p' form (fixed, or tied to a free variable) failed is_atom()'s plain-coordinate check, so it stayed raw text and its '=' swallowed the following line. Fixed by decoding before judging.
fixed_failure_categories.mid_line_equals: multiline_test() treated '=' anywhere as a continuation marker, so 'TITL foo R = 0.40' glued the next line onto itself. Only a trailing '=' continues a line.
fixed_failure_categories.sfac_full_form_keyerror: SFACTable.__repr__ raised KeyError('a1') on a repeated element, and discarded the values of the full exponential form. Both forms are now emitted, duplicates included.
fixed_failure_categories.line_wrap_instability: wrap_line() appended ' =' to a chunk that already ended in a space, emitting '  ='; the run collapsed on the next read.
fixed_failure_categories.afix_code_drift: A knock-on effect of encoded_coordinates: the unparsed atom's '=' swallowed the following AFIX instruction.
fixed_failure_categories.blank_line_wrapping: A whitespace-only line longer than the limit was wrapped, inventing a continuation marker on an empty comment line.
fixed_failure_categories.column_padding: Lines padded to a fixed column width counted their padding toward the wrap limit, splitting a short instruction and leaving whitespace as its continuation.
